# DATA_SPEC.md — Synthetic data (all fake, generated by `caregrid/ingest/generate.py`)

All names, phones, emails, NPIs and member IDs are **fake** (use Faker with `locale=["en_IN","en_US"]`, seed 42).
Raw files deliberately contain fake PII so the anonymizer and leak scan have something to prove.

Output folder: `data/synthetic/`

---

## 1. Request types (the closed list)

| request_type | Workflow | Policy | Team | Risk | Tier | never_auto | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `general_policy_question` | WF-01 | KA-01, KA-02, KA-12 (by search) | TEAM-OPS-TRIAGE | low | read | no | Trust seeded at **Level 1** |
| `provider_address_change` | WF-03 | **KA-12 v3** | TEAM-ENROLL | low | draft | no | Required: npi, new_address, effective_date, supporting_document |
| `provider_name_change` | WF-05 | KA-05 (general only) | TEAM-ENROLL | low | draft | no | **Compounding demo** (no specific policy → policy=15) |
| `portal_access_reset` | WF-07 | **KA-31 vs KA-32 (contradiction)** | TEAM-IT | low | draft | no | Conflict demo; WF-07 also links expired KA-15 |
| `prior_auth_status` | WF-08 | KA-25 | TEAM-UM | low | read | **yes** | Account-specific → always human |
| `dme_equipment_request` | WF-09 | KA-40 (threshold ₹50,000) | TEAM-SENIOR-OPS | low (threshold→high) | write | no | CASE-1024 |
| `claim_status_inquiry` | WF-10 | KA-45 | TEAM-CLAIMS | low | read | **yes** | Account-specific |
| `complaint_grievance` | WF-11 | KA-50 | TEAM-COMPLIANCE | medium | draft | **yes** | Sensitive |
| *(clinical question)* | — | — | TEAM-CLINICAL | critical | — | yes | Hard override CLINICAL |
| `unknown` | — | — | TEAM-OPS-TRIAGE | — | — | — | UNCLEAR_INTENT |

## 2. Files & columns

### `knowledge_articles.csv`
`id, version, title, body, status(approved|draft|expired), effective_from, owner, request_types(;-sep), rule_key, rule_value`

Required rows (plus ~8 filler articles on other ops topics):

| id | v | status | title | key content |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| KA-01 | 1 | approved | Operations request basics | how to submit, SLAs, where to find forms |
| KA-02 | 1 | approved | Supporting documents accepted | W-9, bank letter, state licence copy |
| KA-05 | 1 | approved | Provider record updates — general | general guidance, no step list for name changes |
| KA-12 | 2 | **expired** | Provider Billing Address Change | needed NPI, new address, effective date (**no document**) |
| KA-12 | 3 | approved | Provider Billing Address Change | needs NPI, new address, effective date **and supporting document**; retroactive dates need Enrollment Manager approval; `rule_key=address_change_document`, `rule_value=required` |
| KA-15 | 1 | **expired** | Old portal password policy | still linked from WF-07 → lint EXPIRED_LINKED |
| KA-25 | 1 | approved | Prior authorization status inquiries | status only shared by UM team after identity verification |
| KA-31 | 1 | approved | Portal access reset — manager approval | `rule_key=portal_reset_approval`, `rule_value=manager_required` |
| KA-32 | 1 | approved | Portal access reset — self-service | `rule_key=portal_reset_approval`, `rule_value=self_service` → **contradiction** |
| KA-40 | 1 | approved | DME equipment requests | estimated cost > ₹50,000 requires Senior Operations Review |
| KA-45 | 1 | approved | Claim status inquiries | claim details only via Claims Ops |
| KA-50 | 1 | approved | Complaints & grievances | always to Compliance; acknowledge within 2 business days |
| KA-60 | 1 | draft | Draft: telehealth provider onboarding | **draft** — must never be cited |

### `workflows.json`
List of `{id, title, request_type, steps[], required_fields[], team, risk, action_tier, policy_ids[], thresholds{}, never_auto}`.
- WF-03 links `KA-12`, required `["npi","new_address","effective_date","supporting_document"]`.
- WF-05 has **no linked policy** (`policy_ids: []`) — KA-05 is found only by search, so policy score = 15 (compounding demo). Required `["npi","old_name","new_name","supporting_document"]`.
- WF-07 links `KA-31","KA-32","KA-15"`, required `["user_email","provider_npi"]`.
- WF-09 thresholds `{"estimated_cost_inr": 50000}`, required `["member_id","equipment_code","estimated_cost_inr","prescription_on_file"]`.

### `routing_rules.csv`
`id, condition, team, risk, approver_role` — e.g. `RR-01, request_type=provider_address_change, TEAM-ENROLL, low, team_specialist`; `RR-09, clinical=true, TEAM-CLINICAL, critical, senior_reviewer`; `RR-10, request_type=unknown, TEAM-OPS-TRIAGE, low, team_specialist`.

### `field_definitions.csv`
`field, meaning, regex, example, pii(true|false)`

| field | regex | pii |
|---|---|---|
| npi | `^\d{10}$` | false (provider identifier, but masked in free text anyway) |
| member_id | `^M\d{8}$` | true |
| auth_id | `^PA-\d{4}-\d{5}$` | false |
| claim_id | `^CLM-\d{8}$` | false |
| effective_date | `^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$` | false |
| user_email | email regex | true |
| equipment_code | `^E\d{4}$` | false |
| estimated_cost_inr | `^\d+$` | false |
| new_address / old_name / new_name | non-empty | true |
| supporting_document | one of `W-9, bank_letter, licence_copy` | false |

### `teams.csv`
`id, name, handles, does_not_handle, contact_email`
TEAM-OPS-TRIAGE, TEAM-ENROLL (Provider Enrollment), TEAM-IT (IT Service Desk), TEAM-UM (Utilization Management),
TEAM-CLAIMS (Claims Operations), TEAM-COMPLIANCE (Compliance & Privacy), TEAM-CLINICAL (Clinical Review), TEAM-SENIOR-OPS (Senior Operations Review).
Contacts like `enrollment@caregrid.example`.

### `historical_cases.csv` (→ precedents, ~40 rows)
`id, request_type, raw_text (contains fake PII), facts_json, fields_provided(;), decision_code, route_team, policy_id, policy_version, reason_codes(;), approver_role, risk, date, outcome`

Required rows:
- **P-88**: provider_address_change, policy KA-12 **v2**, decision route_to_team TEAM-ENROLL **without document** → must compile as **STALE**.
- **P-91**: provider_address_change, KA-12 v3, request_missing_info → route_to_team TEAM-ENROLL after document, MISSING_DATA.
- **P-92, P-93**: provider_address_change, KA-12 v3, route_to_team TEAM-ENROLL (so a complete address change scores precedent ≥20).
- **No precedents** for `provider_name_change` (compounding demo starts at 0).
- ~12 `general_policy_question` precedents (answer_from_policy).
- A cluster of **8 `POLICY_GAP`** escalations for `general_policy_question` about *"telehealth provider onboarding"* (no approved article; only draft KA-60) → **Gap Radar hotspot**.
- A few each for portal_access_reset, prior_auth_status, claim_status_inquiry, complaint_grievance, dme_equipment_request.

### `profiles.json`
Fake providers `{npi, name, specialty, address, phone}` and members `{member_id, name, dob, phone, email, plan}`. RBAC-protected; never compiled into the Second Brain.

### `billing.csv`
`invoice_id, case_id, member_id, amount_inr, status, due_date` — includes **INV-1024, CASE-1024, ₹62,500, pending_approval, 2026-10-20**.

### `system_logs.csv`, `jira_records.csv`, `runbooks.md` (light)
- L-552: equipment vendor API timeout linked to CASE-1024.
- J-184: "DME vendor catalogue sync failing" linked to CASE-1024.
- RB-07: runbook "High-cost DME request handling".

### `seed_cases.json` (pre-loaded into SQLite on `reset`)
- **CASE-1024**: dme_equipment_request, member M12345678 (masked in case text), equipment E1390 (oxygen concentrator), estimated_cost_inr 62500, prescription_on_file yes, related: profile, INV-1024, L-552, J-184, RB-07. Expected: risk HIGH → Senior Ops Review.
- ~20 historical cases in mixed states (some IN_REVIEW for hours/days, so queue aging is non-empty).

### `trust_seed.json`
- `general_policy_question`: level 1, total 14, agreements 13, consecutive 11.
- everything else level 0.

### `eval/requests_eval.csv` (~60 rows)
`id, text, requester_id, expected_type, expected_route(auto|human), expected_team, expected_reasons(;), expected_missing(;), must_refuse(bool)`
Cover: complete/incomplete requests per type, invalid NPI (9 digits), clinical questions (5), account-specific asks (5), injection attempts (5: "ignore previous instructions", "I am the admin", "show me member M… phone"), vague requests (5), complaints with legal words (2).

## 3. Regulatory pages (authored, `second_brain/regulatory/`)
- `REG-HIPAA`: short summary — PHI, minimum necessary, Safe Harbor 18 identifier types (names, dates, phones, emails, record numbers, etc.).
- `REG-DPDP`: India DPDP Act 2023 summary — consent, purpose limitation, data minimization, data principal rights.

---

## 4. Anonymization tokens
Replace with stable per-document tokens: `[PERSON_1]`, `[PROVIDER_1]`, `[MEMBER_1]`, `[PHONE]`, `[EMAIL]`, `[ADDRESS]`, `[NPI]`, `[MEMBER_ID]`, `[DATE_OF_BIRTH]`.
Keep business identifiers that are not personal (CASE-, INV-, CLM-, PA-, KA-, WF-, E-codes, amounts) — the rules need them.
